slot_scores.name: profit_calculation
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the primary goal to maximize total monthly profit, calculated as total revenue minus raw material costs and processing fees?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether profit is revenue minus both raw material costs and processing fees, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1 (P1), was resolved by the agent's first question before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent directly clarified the profit definition, the sole hidden slot, and stopped appropriately after resolving it; no silent assumptions were made.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
